<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="חשון_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915193_theRebbe_723" batchId="meluket-_D7_97_D7_A9_D7_95_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915193_theRebbe_723__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the relationship between Yehonasan and Dovid as analogous to Zeir Anpin and Malchus, and describes the future revelation where Malchus will receive directly from Ein Sof and even surpass Zeir Anpin.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And likewise is it with Yehonasan and Dovid,</t>
    <t s="2">that is, Zeir Anpin and Malchus,</t>
    <t s="3">at present,</t>
    <t s="4">Zeir Anpin is above Malchus,</t>
    <t s="5">for Zeir Anpin bestows upon Malchus.</t>
    <t s="6">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="7">the primary virtue is in the drawing down of Zeir Anpin</t>
    <t s="8">(to Malchus),</t>
    <t s="9">and she is remembered.</t>
    <t s="10">And the virtue of "I will visit your dwelling place"</t>
    <t s="11">(the nullification and ascent of Malchus)</t>
    <t s="12">is that through this, "she is remembered" is effected.</t>
    <t s="13">And as explained in the discourses,</t>
    <t s="14">that the elevation of the eve of Rosh Chodesh is so that through this there will be the drawing down on Rosh Chodesh.</t>
    <t s="15">And in the future to come, the aspect of Malchus will be revealed as it is in its own essence,</t>
    <t s="16">that it will receive from Ein Sof Himself</t>
    <t s="17">(like Zeir Anpin).</t>
    <t s="18">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="19">"And the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun,"</t>
    <t s="20">that the moon will shine from itself,</t>
    <t s="21">like the sun.</t>
    <t s="22">And more than this,</t>
    <t s="23">that afterwards the root of Malchus will be revealed, which is above the root of Zeir Anpin, and then Malchus will be above Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="24">"A woman of valor is the crown of her husband."</t>
    <t s="25">And this is what is stated</t>
    <t s="26">(in the haftarah for the day before Rosh Chodesh)</t>
    <t s="27">"Until Dovid became great,"</t>
    <t s="28">that Dovid is above Yehonasan.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section describes the initial stage of Malchus' ascent as its self-nullification into a point under Yesod, which enables higher ascents, and explains that in the future the ascent of "I will visit your dwelling place" will reveal the root of Malchus itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it is known</t>
    <t s="1">that the beginning of the ascent of Malchus is that it becomes nullified from its existence and becomes a point under the Yesod</t>
    <t s="2">[which in general is the matter of "I will visit your dwelling place"],</t>
    <t s="3">and through this it becomes a vessel for ascents above this,</t>
    <t s="4">up to the ascent of "a woman of valor is the crown of her husband."</t>
    <t s="5">And based on this, it can be said,</t>
    <t s="6">that this that the elevation of the eve of Rosh Chodesh</t>
    <t s="7">("I will visit your dwelling place")</t>
    <t s="8">is so that through this on Rosh Chodesh there will be the drawing down from Zeir Anpin</t>
    <t s="9">("and she is remembered"),</t>
    <t s="10">is now,</t>
    <t s="11">but in the future,</t>
    <t s="12">the virtue of "I will visit your dwelling place"</t>
    <t s="13">is that through this the revelation of the root of Malchus itself is drawn.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that sun and moon correspond to the Holy One, blessed be He, and Israel, and that through Israel's self-nullification their essential oneness with G-d is revealed, where they are one with Him and even bestow upon Him.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, this that sun and moon are Zeir Anpin and Malchus is like sun and moon in the matter of the Sefiros.</t>
    <t s="2">But above this,</t>
    <t s="3">sun and moon are the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="4">("Sun is Havayah")</t>
    <t s="5">and Israel</t>
    <t s="6">(who are comparable to the moon).</t>
    <t s="7">And as brought above</t>
    <t s="8">(at the beginning of the maamar)</t>
    <t s="9">from the discourses,</t>
    <t s="10">that "I will visit your dwelling place"</t>
    <t s="11">(of Dovid,</t>
    <t s="12">the moon)</t>
    <t s="13">is the self-nullification of Israel,</t>
    <t s="14">and through this "she is remembered" is effected,</t>
    <t s="15">that the Holy One, blessed be He, is, as it were, reminded of them and remembers them.</t>
    <t s="16">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="17">that just as through "I will visit your dwelling place" of Malchus, its matter and root of Malchus itself are revealed,</t>
    <t s="18">that it does not need to receive from Zeir Anpin</t>
    <t s="19">(the sun),</t>
    <t s="20">and more than this, that through this there will be the ascent of Malchus above Zeir Anpin,</t>
    <t s="21">likewise is it regarding "I will visit your dwelling place" of Israel,</t>
    <t s="22">that through the self-nullification of Israel, their aspect above the aforementioned is revealed,</t>
    <t s="23">that Israel and the Holy One, blessed be He, are completely one,</t>
    <t s="24">therefore they do not, as it were, need to receive from the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="25">for they are truly one,</t>
    <t s="26">and more than this,</t>
    <t s="27">that since "for the work of Your hands You long,"</t>
    <t s="28">Israel are, as it were, bestowers upon the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="29">"a woman of valor is the crown of her husband."</t>
    <t s="30">And this is "and she is remembered, for I will visit your dwelling place,"</t>
    <t s="31">that even though the matter of remembrance is in the level of Ein Sof, before Whom everything is considered as nothing,</t>
    <t s="32">nevertheless, the self-nullification of Israel</t>
    <t s="33">("I will visit your dwelling place")</t>
    <t s="34">arouses in this level that there be "and she is remembered,"</t>
    <t s="35">for this that in order to arouse above it is through the one who arouses having worth and importance,</t>
    <t s="36">is</t>
    <t s="37">when the one who arouses is an existence unto itself,</t>
    <t s="38">but through the self-nullification of "I will visit your dwelling place," their supernal aspect of Israel is revealed, that they are one with the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="39">truly one.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
